audreyality: You noted what it assumes, not how it behaves. This is incorrect because you need to read the code to understand what the effect of that assumption is.

How it behaves is **it saves the file from the current stream position**.

Is this behavior correct? It doesn't seem so. Your replacement comment says **it assumes it's at the beginning of the file**. Maybe you should **guarantee** that instead of assuming it. (That is, practice [defensive programming](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Defensive_programming).)

Some options:
1. Try to move the position back to the beginning of the stream.
2. If the position of the stream is > 0, throw.
